baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative binds an announced event to a demanded time and makes temporal arrival the proposed test of the speakers' truth.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech makes the question a public verbal challenge.
A promise bounded as an appointment supplies the demanded temporal slot.
Occurrence and presence in time make the conditional test the speakers' standing.
Correspondence between statement and fact supplies the explicit truth criterion.

changed_reading.before: They ask when a promised event will happen.
changed_reading.after: They demand that the announced promise be converted into a dated appointment, treating its timing as proof of verbal truth.

baseline_models.mechanism: The question operates as a negotiated burden shift: the hearers withhold assent and demand that the speakers perform their claim by producing its event.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over an affair supplies the adversarial exchange and shifted burden.
Interrogative saying that behaves like supposition makes the question insinuate doubt.
A spoken commitment opens expectation and exposes fulfillment or failure.
Truth realized by deed turns the demanded event into a performance test.

changed_reading.before: The speakers receive a neutral request for chronological information.
changed_reading.after: The challengers use chronology to shift the burden of response, demanding enacted verification before they will credit the warning.

baseline_models.mechanism: The unqualified promise can hold both pledged expectation and threatened harm; the demonstrative challenge flattens that menace into an object the speakers are dared to produce.

activation_trace.role: Promise covering good or evil keeps the announced outcome semantically open.
Threat and intimidation expose the harmful pole hidden inside the generic promise.
Fulfillment by action makes manifestation of the menace the requested verification.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a generic future pledge.
changed_reading.after: The phrase names a threatened consequence whose challengers provocatively demand to see materialized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus demand for a date is framed by two declarations that the word becomes fixed and binding, so the live uncertainty shifts from whether the warning is valid to when an already-settled word manifests.

activation_trace.role: The appointment-like promise anchors the challengers' demand for a date.
Fixed obligation makes the preceding word binding rather than hypothetical.
The articulated word supplies the earlier authoritative speech whose force has settled.
Warning that awakens fear identifies the functional domain of the promised event.
Truth fixed against falsehood repeats the settled status of the word after the focus.
The repeated spoken word closes the frame around the focus challenge.

structural_cues: The formula حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ occurs at 36:7 and returns as وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ at 36:70.
The focus challenge lies between those two word-and-truth formulas.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated fixed-word formulas and the intervening promise question. I infer that the focus promise manifests that authoritative warning; a live alternative is that القول denotes a broader decree rather than the same promised event.

changed_reading.before: The question tests whether the promise has any validity.
changed_reading.after: The question occurs inside an already-binding verdict and can test only the delay before its manifestation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deliverance from immediate destruction is an exception of mercy that extends use of life only to a delimited term; the challengers therefore ask 'when' from inside the very reprieve they misread as nonfulfillment.

activation_trace.role: The appointment-like promise anchors the focus on temporal delimitation.
Will attached to an event supplies the live possibility of immediate destruction.
Merciful tenderness supplies the exception that withholds immediate harm.
Extended preservation makes continued life a temporary allowance rather than evidence of cancellation.
A made-known time for action gives the reprieve a terminal bound.

structural_cues: The exception إِلَّا رَحْمَةً follows the drowning possibility and ends with إِلَىٰ حِينٍ.
Warnings, rejected signs, disputed provision, and the focus challenge follow this reprieve sequence at 36:45-48.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies possible destruction, merciful extension, and a bounded term. I infer that the focus speakers inhabit that extension and mistake delay for failure; alternatively, the term may delimit only the narrated rescue rather than the final promise.

changed_reading.before: Elapsed time weakens the threatened promise.
changed_reading.after: Elapsed time is mercy-borne reprieve with a terminal bound, so the delay presupposed by the challenge belongs to the promise's mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement supplies no calendar answer: expectant waiting and active disputation are seized by one terrifying cry, cutting off testament and return. The event answers the question by interrupting the speech posture that asked it.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation over the matter anchors the focus as an adversarial exchange.
Waiting for a time extends the challengers' posture into the answer scene.
One terrifying cry supplies the abrupt event that replaces a disclosed date.
Seizure and capture make the event overtake rather than negotiate with its hearers.
Contention locates the seizure inside an unfinished quarrel.
An entrusted testament marks the social closure they cannot complete.
Return to what was left behind marks the spatial closure they cannot achieve.

structural_cues: 36:49 begins immediately after the focus and retains the plural subject.
The sequence moves from asking, to disputing, to seizure, to inability without an intervening date.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate adjacency, continued plural agency, dispute, seizure, and incapacity. I infer that the cry is the dramatic answer to the question; alternatively, it may describe the event without presenting its manner as an answer strategy.

changed_reading.before: The question requests an informational reply about a future date.
changed_reading.after: The reply is performative interruption: the promised event arrives while the challengers are still disputing and removes the time needed to finish their affairs.

context_deltas.mechanism: After awakening, the earlier conditional accusation is reversed into recognition using the same promise and truth roots: the experienced event verifies both the promise and its messengers from the challengers' side.

activation_trace.role: The spoken commitment supplies the promise placed under challenge.
Statement-to-fact correspondence supplies the challengers' conditional criterion.
Rousing the still from repose supplies the experiential threshold of recognition.
The same spoken commitment is now identified as the event being experienced.
Fulfillment in action converts disputed truth into acknowledged realization.
The messengers and their message identify whose truth the event confirms.

structural_cues: 36:48 has هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ and صَٰدِقِينَ; 36:52 has هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ and صَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ.
The lexical echo occurs after the cry, awakening, and question from the resting place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an unusually exact lexical reversal after awakening. I infer a discourse-level self-answer by the challenging group; the live alternative is that the later speakers are not individually identical, though the group-level reversal remains.

changed_reading.before: The challengers demand that the messengers prove they are truthful.
changed_reading.after: Their own future recognition supplies the proof: experienced fulfillment forces them to name the promise and affirm the messengers' truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenged 'this promise' later becomes 'this is Hell which you were promised,' followed by 'today.' Demonstrative distance collapses into present encounter, and the requested when becomes the day of exposure to the threat.

activation_trace.role: Threat and intimidation identify the harmful pole of the challenged promise.
Past temporal presence links the addressed group to its prior promised status.
The threatening promise is identified with the now-present object of judgment.
Meeting the fire and its heat turns verbal menace into bodily encounter.
The bounded day supplies the eventual answer to the focus question when.
Concealment of truth supplies the causal relation between prior denial and present judgment.

structural_cues: The focus هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ is answered by 36:63 هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ.
36:64 immediately adds ٱلْيَوْمَ and an imperative of entering the fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the demonstrative recurrence, repeated promise root, and immediate 'today.' I infer a deliberate deictic-temporal inversion of the focus taunt; alternatively, the passages can mark separate discourse stages without making the later demonstrative a direct verbal answer.

changed_reading.before: This promise is a rhetorically distant object whose date can be mocked.
changed_reading.after: The same threat becomes a present object and a bounded today, leaving the challengers inside the temporal answer they demanded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human saying separates speech from event and demands proof that the promise will occur; the closing divine command joins saying to coming-to-be, recasting truth as realization under will rather than dependence on advance calendar disclosure.

activation_trace.role: Human utterance supplies the verbal challenge that treats speech and event as separable.
The commitment projects an event not yet visible to the challengers.
Occurrence in time anchors the challenged relation between claim and event.
Truth realized by action supplies the bridge the challengers demand.
Binding command supplies authoritative direction toward realization.
Will and volition supply the condition governing when realization occurs.
Divine utterance repeats the focus speech root under a different agent.
Commanded being and resultant occurrence close the gap between saying and event.

structural_cues: 36:48 begins with plural human saying and asks whether the promise will prove true.
36:82 closes with divine saying followed by كُن فَيَكُونُ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the agent contrast and repeated saying/being roots. I supply the causal arrow from divine utterance to realization; a live alternative is that the formula marks effortless authority without describing speech as a literal causal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Truth depends on whether a prior statement later corresponds to an independently arriving event.
changed_reading.after: The surah's closing speech model makes the promised event realizable by authoritative command, so refusal to disclose its date does not weaken its truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later instruction not to grieve at 'their saying,' paired with knowledge of what they hide and publicize, recasts the focus question as an affectively aimed discourse practice rather than a transparent request for information.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulating among people makes the focus challenge a repeatable public line.
Inner roughness through grief identifies the saying's emotional effect on its addressee.
Their circulating saying gathers the focus taunt into a broader hostile speech stream.
Disclosure to the knower removes any informational advantage created by the challenge.
Hidden inward content supplies a concealed layer behind the public question.
Open declaration supplies the public layer through which the challenge exerts pressure.

structural_cues: 36:76 refers collectively to قَوْلُهُمْ and immediately contrasts what they conceal with what they declare.
The focus is itself introduced as repeated plural speech: وَيَقُولُونَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated plural saying, its grieving effect, and the hidden/public contrast. I infer that the focus question participates in this provocative speech practice; alternatively, قولهم may gather many sayings without singling out 36:48.

changed_reading.before: The question straightforwardly exposes a lack of chronological knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The question is also a public taunt with concealed commitments, designed to pressure or grieve rather than merely to learn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant و ع د to ع د د mapping and joins it to celestial recurrence; it remains anchored in the focus promise and its explicit question when, but downstream prose should present it only as packet-induced temporal resonance, not as the lexical derivation of وعد.

activation_trace.role: Counted time and its recurrence turn the focus promise into a term whose temporal return can be challenged.
A measure that brings a thing to its limit supplies exact boundedness in the cosmic order.
Return after departure supplies visible recurrence through the moon's phases.
A set time for action connects measured recurrence to the terminal bound of reprieve.

changed_reading.before: The challengers ask for an unspecified date.
changed_reading.after: They demand visibility of a countable term, while the surrounding measured cycles imply that hidden timing can still be ordered and bounded.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because it transfers the branch image of a promising land, day, or omen to revealed signs; it remains anchored in ٱلْوَعْدُ and the immediately preceding signs, but downstream prose should qualify it as an analogy of portent rather than redefine the promise as an omen.

activation_trace.role: A promising indication from which a coming state is expected lets the promise function as portent.
Visible marks supply the signs that already indicate the coming state.
Turning one's side away supplies the mechanism by which present portents are refused.

changed_reading.before: They wait for an absent future pledge to become visible.
changed_reading.after: They stand amid signs that already portend the promised state, then ask for the promise only after turning away from its present indications.

strongest_changes: The immediate answer is not a date but a cry that seizes the challengers while they are still disputing.
At 36:52 the future awakened speakers reverse صادقين into صدق المرسلون and recognize the very promise they challenged.
At 36:63-64 'this promise' becomes 'this is Hell' and 'today,' collapsing deictic and temporal distance.
At 36:82 human questioning speech is answered by authoritative saying joined to coming-to-be.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence transformed a bare timing challenge into a sequence of reprieve, interruption, compelled self-verification, present judgment, and enactive speech while preserving exploratory count-and-portent branches.
remaining_uncertainties: The equation of the fixed القول at 36:7 and 36:70 with the focus وعد is strongly framed but reader-supplied.
The reprieve at 36:44 may delimit rescue from drowning rather than the final promised event.
The speakers at 36:52 need not be individually identical to those at 36:48.
The counted-term and portent readings depend on deliberately exploratory branch transfer and should remain qualified.
